Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • IPA(key): /tɾaˈθeɾ/ [t̪ɾaˈθeɾ]
  • IPA(key): (standard) /tɾaˈθeɾ/ [t̪ɾaˈθeɾ]
  • IPA(key): (seseo) /tɾaˈseɾ/ [t̪ɾaˈseɾ]

  • Rhymes: -eɾ
  • Hyphenation: tra‧zer

Verb

[edit]

trazer (first-person singular present trago, first-person singular preterite trouxem or trouxe, past participle trazido, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of traer

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • trajer (dialectal)
  • traguer (Minho, Beira)

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese trager, from Vulgar Latin tragere, from Latin trahere. Cognate of Spanish traer, French traire, and Italian trarre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾaˈze(ʁ)/ [tɾaˈze(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾaˈze(ʁ)/ [tɾaˈze(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /tɾaˈze(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /tɾaˈze(ʁ)/ [tɾaˈze(χ)]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾaˈze(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /tɾɐˈzeɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /tɾɐˈzeɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /tɾɐˈze.ɾi/

  • (Rural Central Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾɐˈze(ɹ)/
  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: tra‧zer

Verb

[edit]

trazer (first-person singular present trago, first-person singular preterite trouxe, past participle trazido)

  1. bring (to transport toward somebody/somewhere)
